source_union.interpretation: Conservative complete-story superset of reproduced 007 corpus and declared lower-prefix roles; not a claim that all source unknowns/reservation tails are resolved

views.r3m4096_raw: Exact original tokenizer 612c2aaa09e7f35c89c41c1e6270bdca1ef861a283a4de859cd808c8e6bfe6ff, original raw text, EOS after each story
views.historical2048_strip: Original tokenizer becc6a25669e0f66424244f19fc846dfd8304bfd529c6187d772e8f961233be2, str.strip as historical loader, EOS after each nonempty encoded story; full terminal story is an explicit over-exclusion
views.nfkc_words: NFKC then casefold then Unicode regex \w+; words identified by full SHA256, shared deterministic vocabulary; explicit non-word story-boundary sentinel

window_policy: All stride-1 fragments of every fixed candidate story including EOS, compared with every same-length position in the source stream; historical streams concatenate across stories with EOS/sentinel and do not reset at processing chunks
candidate_boundary_policy: No fragments connecting different Main candidates
cross_tokenizer_policy: Never compare numeric IDs across different vocabularies; compare within each tokenizer view and supplement with normalized word fragments
hash_filter: uint64 polynomial hash base 1000003 modulo 2^64, token value plus 1
collision_resolution: Mandatory exact elementwise comparison of the entire sequence on each hash hit; no hash-only matches
evidence: Count all occurrences; retain first three source positions per matching unique fragment. Fixed first 128 pattern IDs per view/length as public examples; complete counts retained in private local index artifacts with SHA256. No raw text or quality output published
decision: Report overlap by view/length and candidate. Nonzero overlap is not automatically a semantic contamination verdict. Zero overlap in this partial source universe is not a global PASS. Proof B and fragment release semantics require independent scientific review
